description: Each exported spec inside a Go `var ( … )` group is recorded as a Value export at its spec's line, exactly as a `const ( … )` spec is, and nothing else about Go export extraction changes.

specs.description: An exported var inside a var group is an export of kind Value at its spec's line
specs.given: A Go file `pkg/config.go` whose line 1 is `package pkg`, line 3 is `var (`, line 4 is `	Timeout = 30`, and line 5 is `)`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: The result contains exactly one ExportDeclaration named `Timeout`, with file `pkg/config.go`, line 4, kind ExportKind::Value and hexa_public false

specs.description: Every exported spec in a var group is recorded, each at its own line
specs.given: A Go file with `var (` on line 3, `	A = 1` on line 4, `	B string` on line 5, `	C, D = 2, 3` on line 6, and `)` on line 7
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: The exports include `A` at line 4, `B` at line 5, and `C` and `D` both at line 6, all of kind Value

specs.description: A grouped var and a grouped const with the same shape produce the same export record
specs.given: Two Go files that differ only in the keyword: one has `var (` on line 3 and `	Limit = 5` on line 4, the other has `const (` on line 3 and `	Limit = 5` on line 4
specs.when: extract_exports is called on each with Language::Go
specs.then: Each yields an export named `Limit` at line 4 of kind Value with hexa_public false; the two records agree in name, line, kind and hexa_public

specs.description: A grouped exported var that nothing uses is reported as a dead export
specs.given: A Go project in which `internal/domain/vars.go` declares `var (\n\tUnusedFlag = true\n)` and no other file in the project names `UnusedFlag`
specs.when: The project is analyzed for dead exports
specs.then: The dead exports include one entry with file `internal/domain/vars.go`, export_name `UnusedFlag` and the line of its spec

specs.description: A grouped exported var used elsewhere in the project is not a dead export
specs.given: A Go project in which `a/vars.go` declares `var (\n\tShared = 1\n)` and `a/use.go`, in the same package, refers to `Shared`
specs.when: The project is analyzed for dead exports

specs.description: A grouped var must not be left out of the exports
specs.given: A Go file whose only declaration is `var (\n\tTimeout = 30\n)`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: The result is not empty and contains an export named `Timeout`

specs.description: A grouped var must not be recorded with a kind other than Value or at a line other than its spec's
specs.given: A Go file with `var (` on line 3 and `\tTimeout = 30` on line 4
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: The `Timeout` export has kind Value, not Function, Type, Method, Impl or Default, and its line is 4, not 3 (the line of the `var` keyword)

specs.description: Grouping an exported var does not change its export record
specs.given: Any upper-case identifier N and any valid Go initializer, written once ungrouped as `var N = <init>` with the spec on line L, and once grouped as `var (` followed by `N = <init>` with the spec on line L
specs.when: extract_exports is called on each with Language::Go
specs.then: Both yield exactly one export named N, at line L, of kind Value, with the same hexa_public value

specs.description: Exactly the upper-case names in a var group are recorded, with no duplicates
specs.given: Any Go file whose only declaration is a `var ( … )` group with any mix of specs, each declaring one or more names that start with an upper-case or lower-case letter
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: The set of export names equals the set of declared names starting with an upper-case letter; each appears once, of kind Value, at the line of the spec that declares it

specs.description: Ungrouped vars, const groups, type groups, functions and methods are still read as before
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: The exports include `Single` (Value), `Max` (Value), `User` (Type), `Run` (Function) and `Name` (Method), each at its own line

specs.description: Only the export kind and record of the grouped var are new: a mixed file gains exactly the grouped vars
specs.given: A Go file containing `var Single = 1`, `func Run() {}`, and `var (\n\tGrouped = 2\n)`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: The exports are exactly `Single`, `Run` and `Grouped`, with no other entries

specs.description: A grouped var whose name Go does not export is not an export
specs.given:
A Go file whose only declaration is `var (
	internalCount = 0
	_ = 1
)`
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: The result contains no export named `internalCount` and no export named `_`

specs.description: A var declared inside a function body, grouped or not, is not an export
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: The result contains no export named `Local` and no export named `Other`

specs.description: Unexported ungrouped vars, consts, types and functions do not become exports
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go

specs.description: A file with no var group has the same exports it always had
specs.given: Any Go file containing no `var ( … )` group, with any mix of functions, methods, ungrouped vars, ungrouped or grouped consts, and ungrouped or grouped types
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: Every exported function is recorded as Function, every method as Method, every type spec as Type, and every exported const or ungrouped var spec as Value, each at its declaration's line; nothing else is recorded

specs.description: No lower-case grouped var name is ever an export
specs.given: Any Go file containing any number of `var ( … )` groups with names of any case
specs.when: extract_exports is called on it with Language::Go
specs.then: No export has a name whose first character is not an upper-case letter
